newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures closed mixed on Friday, as some contracts recovered from earlier losses after the yen's fall against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen lower to 0.4 yen higher, with the benchmark September up 0.4 yen at 145.0 yen per kg.

Market sentiment was bearish in the morning session, as local investors covered long positions, traders said. The yen's fall triggered light buying later, but that failed to boost all contracts, they said. Talk that Chinese rubber buyers have made some inquiries failed to encourage Japanese investors, they said. - Tokyo Commodities Desk (+81-3-3432-7391)
